integrity: The proof is an exact algebraic comparison of the published first-order Liu equations with the published second-order reduction. No numerical trajectory evidence is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the specific SODE transformation printed for the classical Liu system; it does not construct a constrained KCC formalism.
It does not assert that every Jacobi-instability conclusion in the source is false; the original origin is independently linearly unstable in the x-y block.
Targeted searches did not find a Liu-specific prior statement of the constraint defect, but an unindexed correction remains possible.
title: The KCC second-order Liu system contains an exponentially repelling extraneous mode
